methodology.main: Vite 8 Oxc-minified ESM closure of the packed main entry with Rolldown cwd pinned to the extracted package root so generated module-region identifiers are artifact-relative. Maskito and tabbable runtime dependencies are bundled; React, React DOM, MUI, Emotion, RHF and Zod peers plus libphonenumber-js metadata are external because metadata has a separate budget.
methodology.server: Direct tsdown neutral-platform server entry, excluding metadata presets.
